name: Forsake
overview: The biblical concept of 'forsake' emphasizes God's unwavering presence and faithfulness toward His people, assuring them that He will never abandon or leave them, as affirmed in Hebrews 13:5. This promise brings rest and confidence, echoing God's assurance in Exodus 33:14 that His presence accompanies His followers. Additionally, believers are called to remain steadfast in their fellowship and obedience, as seen in Hebrews 10:25, which exhorts them not to forsake assembling together. Together, these verses highlight both God's enduring commitment and the believer's responsibility to persevere in faith and community.
